decisions.rationale: Simpler model: every request carries fresh TOTP. MTM validates against stored secret. Adapter gets in-memory copy to validate independently. Phase 1 uses dummy tokens for infrastructure; Phase 4 adds real TOTP.

decisions.decision: Adapter validates only session_token (not separate cli_2fa_token)
decisions.rationale: MTM already verified TOTP before spawning adapter. Adapter only needs to bind CLI to this specific adapter session. This reduces secret distribution and crypto complexity.
Avoid /proc exposure; minimize credential lifetime in memory
Per-user, per-type isolation. predictable naming. Control socket separate from CLI traffic.
Simple line-based framing. Peer credentials verification prevents impersonation. Error format standardized.

decisions.decision: Dummy adapter realistic simulation with varying device names and artificial delays
decisions.rationale: Ensures test suite exercises same code paths as real adapter without needing actual VPN connection. Makes tests deterministic yet realistic.
